extraction_notes: This is a multi-product Pacific Life "Workforce Benefits Proposal" document covering Dental, Vision, Basic Life/AD&D, Voluntary Life/AD&D, STD, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, and Accident products - only the Vision section should be extracted per instructions. Vision section is titled "Group Vision Insurance - Classic-16" (page labeled "Vision Insurance Powered by EyeMed® - Classic-16") and is a SINGLE plan/product (only one vision plan offered in this document - confirm count of 1 plan when extracting). Layout: header block gives Effective Date, Rate Guarantee, Situs State. A "Monthly Premiums" table gives 4-tier rates (Employee Only, Employee+Spouse, Employee+Children, Employee+Family) - map directly to employee_only/employee_spouse/employee_children/family. An "Employees Eligible for Coverage / Minimum Participation Requirement / Minimum Hours for Eligibility" table follows (not needed in schema but useful context). A "Covered Services / Benefit Frequencies" table lists Exams, Diabetic Exam Benefit, Frames, Eyeglass Lenses, Contact Lenses frequencies. The detailed cost-share table (In-Network vs Out-of-Network) appears on the NEXT page under "Vision Insurance Powered by EyeMed®" header, broken into EXAMS, EYEGLASSES (Frames, Eyeglass Lenses sub-rows including single vision/bifocal/trifocal/lenticular/standard progressive/premium progressive tiers 1-4, Lens Options: Polycarbonate under 19, Scratch resistant coating), and CONTACT LENSES (elective, non-elective, standard/premium fit+follow up). Both In-Network and Out-of-Network columns should be captured - put In-Network values in 'benefits' and Out-of-Network in 'out_of_network', keyed by matching labels. No deductible/OOP max fields apply to vision - omit those. Additional discount info (40% off extra eyeglasses, 15% off contacts, LASIK discounts, hearing aid discounts via Amplifon) and exclusions appear on subsequent pages but are narrative, not per-plan rate data - not needed in structured extraction. Document also states producer commission (Level 10%) and policy form series (PLAVIPOL22/PLAVICERT22) at the end of the vision section - these are administrative, not required fields. Other products (Dental, Life, STD, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Accident) appear before/after Vision in this doc but must be ignored when only Vision is requested.
